title: Skipped website releases are no longer reported as failures
summary: When a newer update reaches the website before an older one finishes its checks, the older one now stops cleanly as superseded instead of being reported as a failed release. The newer update is still the one that goes live.
items: A superseded update changes nothing on the website or in the database, exactly as before.
Release history and the changelog only count updates that actually went live and passed their live checks.
A release that really fails is still reported as a failure.
